buzz.title: Daily Buzz
buzz.content:
━━ LOCAL ━━

1) CRYSTAL MOUNTAIN COULD SELL OR TAKE ON A PARTNER
• Family is exploring a sale OR a partner, and MacInnes says "we don't have to really sell"
• Benzie County's largest employer, running business as usual
• $200 million+ invested since 1989, 70 years old this year
• Any buyer needs deep pockets AND matching values
➜ TAKE: Crystal is where half of Northern Michigan learned to ski and the other half learned to fall down. Whoever buys it better keep the Buck in Buck Hills.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's your best Crystal Mountain memory?

2) SANDHILL CRANES ARE PEAKING RIGHT NOW
• Migration peaks right about now, mid-November
• Hundreds to thousands roost in shallow wetlands and feed in harvested corn fields
• That bugling, "prehistoric" call is what you're hearing overhead
• Mild weather could keep them in Michigan into December
➜ TAKE: If you heard a pterodactyl over the Meijer parking lot this weekend, relax. It was a sandhill crane.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: where have you seen the biggest flock of cranes up here?

3) FISHPASS IS GETTING A KAYAK SLIDE
• New aluminum kayak slide and launch at the Union Street Dam
• Paddle from Boardman Lake to Grand Traverse Bay without hauling your boat
• Still under construction, opening expected summer 2027
➜ TAKE: A water slide for grown-ups in the middle of downtown. I've never wanted summer 2027 more.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: would you be first in line to ride the kayak slide, or is that a hard no?

━━ BITS ━━

50s IN NOVEMBER
• It's mid-November and we're near 60 all week. Are you putting the Christmas lights up NOW in the sunshine, or waiting until it's 20 and sleeting like a true Michigander?

THE THERMOSTAT WAR
• It's that time of year. What's the number in your house, 68 or 70, and who keeps sneaking over to change it?

THE GERMAN FOOTBALL KING
• The Lions played in Munich in front of a record crowd. If the Lions played overseas again, would you go? And what city?

━━ SPORTS ━━

KINGSLEY IS GOING TO THE SEMIS (12-0)
• Kingsley 34, Sanford Meridian 28, Division 6 regional final Friday at Kingsley, in the snow
• Down 22-14 at halftime, the Stags scored in the final minute, then a sack with 13 seconds left sealed it
• NEXT: Division 6 state semifinal vs. Almont (12-0), Saturday, Nov. 21, at Clare High School (time TBA)
• Going for a second straight trip to the state final

ST. FRANCIS VOLLEYBALL'S RUN ENDS
• Calumet beat St. Francis 3-0 (25-19, 25-8, 25-10) in Thursday's Division 3 regional final in Manistique
• The Gladiators finish 30-18-2

BAY REPS HOCKEY IS UNBEATEN
• Boys: beat Alpena 3-1 Saturday and Cranbrook 4-2 Thursday, now 2-0
• Girls: 3-0 to start, outscoring teams 22-2 over the weekend

UP NORTH STATE RUNS
• Gaylord St. Mary (12-0) beat Portland St. Patrick 39-36 and plays for the 8-player Division 2 title vs. Mendon (12-0), Saturday, Nov. 21, 2 PM at the Superior Dome in Marquette, its first final since 2002
• Roscommon volleyball plays Calumet in a Division 3 state quarterfinal Tuesday, 6 PM, in Gaylord
• Charlevoix's football season ended at Menominee Saturday
• Every other area team on our list is done for the season

LIONS 35, PATRIOTS 10 (7-2)
• Five straight wins, in Munich, in front of a record crowd of 70,225
• Amon-Ra St. Brown ran out with a German flag and scored twice, including a 56-yarder
• Jahmyr Gibbs: 252 total yards and two TDs
• Bad news: Aidan Hutchinson hurt his right knee celebrating a sack, and an AP source says it's season-ending

MICHIGAN AND MICHIGAN STATE
• Michigan lost at No. 18 Oregon, 31-7
• Michigan State lost to Washington, 21-14

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
CATCH THE SUN WHILE IT'S HERE

We've got a sunny, mild week ahead of us, near 50 today, and in Northern Michigan in the middle of November that's a gift we don't get many more of. The days are getting short, though, since the sun didn't come up until about 7:40 this morning, and when we go from a dark house to a dark car to a desk all day, our mood and our sleep feel it. So here's your move for today. Sometime before lunch, step outside for ten minutes in the daylight. Take your coffee out on the porch, walk out to the mailbox the long way, or just stand in the parking lot and face the sun. Researchers who looked at about four hundred thousand people in the UK found that the more time people spent in outdoor daylight, the better their mood and the easier their sleep, because that bright light helps set your body clock for the whole day. So while the sun is showing up for us this week, let's show up for it too. That's your Mental Health Minute on Z93. Text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me where you caught your ten minutes of sun today.
mental.notes:
Evidence: Scullin et al., 2018, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General (Baylor University). Writing a specific to-do list before bed was linked to falling asleep faster than writing about completed tasks. This is a sleep-onset finding, not a clinical claim.
Move is new this week (week-used reset). It's different from last week's 'Let the Phone Sleep in the Kitchen.' Indoor move, fine for any weather.
Source: Burns et al. 2021, J Affective Disorders (UK Biobank, ~400k), outdoor light, mood and sleep.

flash.title: Flashback
chart_records: First hip-hop single to hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 (chart dated Nov. 3, 1990; one week at No. 1)
UK Official Singles Chart No. 1 for four weeks (from the week of Dec. 1, 1990)
Album To the Extreme spent 16 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200
flash.origin: The song first came out as the B-side of Vanilla Ice's cover of "Play That Funky Music" on Ichiban, around his 1989 Hooked album. DJs flipped the record, the B-side took off, and SBK issued it as its own single in 1990. The "Ice Ice Baby" chant comes from the signature chant of the historically Black fraternity Alpha Phi Alpha. The hook samples the bassline of Queen and David Bowie's 1981 hit "Under Pressure"; they were not credited at first, then a settlement added Queen and Bowie to the songwriting credits.
flash.content:
VANILLA ICE, "ICE ICE BABY" (1990) — for Rob Farmer
• First hip-hop single to hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 (week of Nov. 3, 1990)
• Also a UK No. 1 — four weeks on top
• The album To the Extreme spent 16 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200
• It started as the B-side of his "Play That Funky Music" cover; DJs flipped the record and this side took off
• The "Ice Ice Baby" chant comes from the Alpha Phi Alpha fraternity chant
• The bassline is from Queen and David Bowie's "Under Pressure" — they later got songwriting credit
flash.notes:
Sources: Billboard, first hip-hop Hot 100 No. 1 on the Nov. 3, 1990 chart: https://www.billboard.com/pro/hip-hop-hot-100-firsts-vanilla-ice/ · Billboard artist chart (1 week at No. 1, peak date 11/03/90): https://www.billboard.com/artist/vanilla-ice/ · Official Charts, UK No. 1 for 4 weeks from 01/12/1990: https://www.officialcharts.com/songs/vanilla-ice-ice-ice-baby/ · Billboard on To the Extreme's 16 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, and Queen/Bowie credits added the week the single hit No. 1 (no lawsuit filed): https://www.worldradiohistory.com/hd2/IDX-Business/Music/Billboard-Index/IDX/2015/2015-38-11-14-Issue-34-Billboard-Page-0074.pdf · SBK A-side single dated Aug. 22, 1990; B-side history and Alpha Phi Alpha chant: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_Ice_Baby · Hooked on Ichiban in 1989: AllMusic https://www.allmusic.com/album/hooked-mw0000317619 and official site https://www.vanillaice.com/hooked · Alpha Phi Alpha also confirmed by Vanilla Ice (VladTV) and The Ringer https://www.theringer.com/2020/10/06/music/vanilla-ice-to-the-extreme-ice-ice-baby-history-30th-anniversary
Nuance, not for air unless asked: the hit single is the 1990 SBK A-side; the Ichiban B-side came first (Hooked era, 1989 per AllMusic and the official site; Wikipedia's To the Extreme page also says early 1990 in the body). Do not name the DJ who flipped it — accounts split between David Morales and Darrell J at WAGH in Columbus, Ga. Skip "wrote it as a teen" — Wikipedia says 1983 at 16, The Ringer has Ice saying circa 1988 at 20. Billboard frames this as the first hip-hop/all-rap Hot 100 No. 1; Blondie's "Rapture" (1981) had a rap verse but is not counted as a hip-hop single. Do not use the later claim that he bought the publishing on "Under Pressure" (Queen disputed it).
earlier pick: Roxette, "Joyride" (1991) — their fourth and final No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 (May 11, 1991); tied to AAA's Thanksgiving road-trip forecast. Billboard: https://www.billboard.com/pro/roxette-joyride-forever-no-1/ · AAA 11/16 release.

OUT: "...one time he had to wear a toboggan." (1:48)
~47 s · PLAY
➜ WHY: It's dead-center for women 25-55, and it sets up the thermostat-war bit

🎙️ SET UP: A stray mama dog dropped her four puppies with a family, then came back that night with four MORE. All eight found homes. "This mom really said, here, watch the kids."
• A stray mom drops four puppies with a family, then comes back at night with four MORE
🔊 IN: "Ma'am, that mama dog really said, I can't handle these kids anymore" (0:00)
OUT: "...I felt really honored that she trusted us enough with the four." (0:47)
~47 s · PLAY (music bed under)
➜ WHY: Every tired parent relates to dropping the kids off, and it has a happy ending: all eight found homes

🎙️ SET UP: Saturday SpaceX caught a returning Starship with its launch tower for the first time ever. Sonic boom first, then the crowd loses it. "Listen for the boom..."
• SpaceX's launch tower caught a returning Starship for the first time, and the crowd lost it
🔊 IN: "There's the sonic boom. Starship returning." (4:46) → "Let's go Ship 42" (4:57)
then: "Mechazilla has caught the Starship..." (6:43) OUT: "...Baby, she's back." (6:55)
~25 s edited · PLAY
➜ WHY: A real 'you had to hear it' moment, a sonic boom plus a screaming crowd, and it works without the picture
clips.notes:
c01: NFL official YouTube, 'German Football King Amon-Ra St. Brown scores the first TD in Munich!' (1:08, 161K views at scan) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fpWGgoCOYwg. Start at 0:07, because the first 6 s are about Hutchinson's injury ('nightmare scenario'). FOX broadcast audio, play-by-play by Joe.
c02: SNL official: 'Weekend Update: Tommy Brennan Performs an Original Thanksgiving Song - SNL' (Sat 11/14, 3:35) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H7Q_wnltz0w. Recut v2 (Mon 11/16 ~10:47 AM ET) is the full song only: /workspace/morning-rush/clips/2026-11-16/c02-snl-thanksgiving-song-v2.mp3 (2:34, 154 s). Starts just before the first sung line ("I've been home for 20 seconds") and runs through the last "Happy turkey day, to you." Intro talk, applause, and Colin's outro are trimmed. Old cut kept at weekend-update-2026-11-14.mp3 (47.5 s, intro + first verse only). No bleeps (no listed swears). AIR FLAGS for AJ: (1) Grandma asks 'if I'll have kids before she dies' (mild/dark, already flagged). (2) Uncle bathroom verse: 'his penis looks just like my dad's' and a spoken 'fully naked too' aside — crude/sexual, rule of three, AJ's call. (3) Grandpa 'Chris Columbus was a hero' and 'boycotted the NFL since Kaepernick took a knee' — politics-adjacent, AJ's call. (4) Coming-out verse and 'you can still be mean if you're gay,' plus a spoken story about dad finding out. Longer than the usual 30–90 s target because Truce asked for the complete song.
c03: Dry Bar Comedy official, 'People Don't Respect My Fear of Cats | Ahmed Bharoocha' (uploaded ~11/14, 9:25) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z02Yg9fAqCM. Clean in the transcript.
c04: Dry Bar Comedy official, 'Nobody Warned Me About What Happens After 40 | Leanne Morgan' (~11/9, 8:42) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tp0TmcFbSzo. Clean within IN/OUT (it mentions perimenopause and night sweats, which is fine for the demo). DO NOT run past 1:48, because the next beagle bit (~2:18 and 3:48) has a crude anatomical line.
c07: The Dodo official, 'Stray Mama Dog Keeps Dropping Off Her Puppies For Babysitting' (~11/14, 3:16, 100K views) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5bwH4iclH4c. Use the first story only (0:00-1:31). The second segment is a different rescue.
c08: SpaceX official, 'SpaceX Catches Starship for the First Time Ending Flight Test 15' (Sat 11/14) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VEvzBhRyB94. Two-piece edit. The 5:16-6:40 cheering stretch had garbled auto-captions, so listen through for stray words before airing.
Scan: SNL, Fallon, Kimmel (weekend monologues are political, so skipped), Dry Bar, Netflix Is A Joke (nothing fresh), The Dodo, ViralHog, NFL YouTube. YouTube Trending, TikTok Creative Center, Google Trends, Pop Crave/X, House of Highlights, Storyful, Bored Panda, KYM, Reddit and GoodNewsNetwork were NOT checked this run (the run was kept lean).
